trigger_cases.prompt: Measure why this Cargo workspace builds slowly and give me one reproducible experiment.
trigger_cases.rationale: Requests the build-time diagnosis and bounded comparison loop owned by this Skill.

trigger_cases.prompt: Compare cold and warm Rust builds without leaving target artifacts in my repository.
trigger_cases.rationale: Names the isolated cold and warm measurement contract implemented by the script.

trigger_cases.prompt: Audit whether a Cargo configuration change improves build time with like-for-like evidence.
trigger_cases.rationale: Requests a controlled before-and-after build-performance experiment.

trigger_cases.prompt: Profile this Rust server's runtime CPU and memory usage under production load.
trigger_cases.rationale: Runtime profiling is different from Cargo compilation performance.

trigger_cases.prompt: Release this crate to crates.io and create the GitHub Release.
trigger_cases.rationale: Crate publication is an external release workflow with irreversible side effects.

trigger_cases.prompt: Upgrade every Rust dependency to its newest version.
trigger_cases.rationale: Dependency upgrades change source resolution and are outside a controlled measurement.

trigger_cases.prompt: Delete every Cargo target directory on this machine.
trigger_cases.rationale: Destructive cleanup is explicitly excluded from the isolated measurement workflow.

originality.rationale: The compared capabilities gate publication artifacts; this Skill instead produces isolated cold and warm Cargo timing evidence and a single-factor optimization experiment.
